name: Pretture
description_en:
Pretture is an ERP designed for fashion brands with showroom orders, unique finished pieces, consignments and production/jobwork. Its current site distinguishes Retail, Production and Retail + Production packages.

The inventory model is specific to designer operations: a particular piece can move through showrooms, stockists, stylists and exhibitions while made-to-measure orders and outsourced production remain linked to business records.
description_zh:
Pretture 是面向时尚品牌的 ERP，覆盖展厅订单、独立成品件、寄售及生产外协。当前官网区分 Retail、Production 与 Retail + Production。

库存模型针对设计师品牌：特定单件可在展厅、买手店、造型师和展会间流转，同时将量身定制订单和外包生产关联业务记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Finished pieces have unique piececodes with barcode/RFID-enabled tracking across sites and external holders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 成品使用独立件码，并以条码或 RFID 跟踪跨地点及外部持有人流转。

core_features.explanation_en: The public site describes BOMs, materials, component production, jobwork, issue records and process costs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官网描述物料清单、材料、组件生产、外协、领料和工序成本。

en: Follow a piece through consignment and return
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

pricing.billing_basis: Quote by Retail, Production or combined modules, locations, integrations, brand size and implementation; no numeric public amount.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Quote by Retail, Production or combined modules, locations, integrations, brand size and implementation; no numeric public amount.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按 Retail、Production 或组合模块、地点、集成、品牌规模与实施询价，无公开数值金额。

sources.title: Pretture ERP | Retail & Production ERP for Designer Fashion Brands
sources.research_notes_en: Read complete current fashion-specific piececode, MBO, made-to-measure, jobwork and implementation descriptions.

sources.title: Pretture ERP Packages - Prêtture
sources.research_notes_en: Read three package paths and quote dimensions; no numeric public fee established.

official_check.scope: Public official pages read and bilingual draft cross-checked; no account, purchase, execution, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Follow a piece through consignment and return
sections.en: Use one finished piececode to send stock to an MBO/stockist, record the dispatch document, upload or enter the sale report and return the unsold piece. The site distinguishes challan and consignment-on-invoice flows. Test markdowns and aging visibility with the actual commercial arrangement rather than treating an external location as an ordinary owned showroom.
sections.zh: 用一个成品件码将商品寄给 MBO 或买手店，记录发货单、上传或录入销售报告，并退回未售单件。官网区分 challan 及按发票寄售流程。应结合真实商务安排测试折价和账龄，不能把外部地点简单视为自营展厅。

sections.title_zh: 将客户承诺与外协生产连接
sections.en: Made-to-measure orders can hold measurements, reference images, due dates and inventory blocking. Production material describes BOM reservation, cutting/embroidery or other jobwork, material issues and overdue process alerts. A proposed pilot follows an order through one outside vendor and an alteration, checking whether the correct piece remains committed throughout.
sections.zh: 量身定制订单可记录尺寸、参考图、交期及库存占用。生产资料描述物料清单预留、裁剪或刺绣外协、领料和工序逾期提醒。可试点一个经过外部供应商与修改的订单，检查全过程是否持续占用正确单件。

sections.title_zh: 按零售与生产模块组合询价
sections.en: No numeric subscription price is published in the current package page. Retail covers orders, finished goods and distribution; Production covers purchase, materials, BOMs and jobwork; the combined package connects both. Quotes depend on modules, locations, integrations, brand size and implementation scope. No universal per-MBO surcharge should be inferred from a generic POS model; the site explicitly distinguishes its MBO handling.
sections.zh: 当前套餐页不公开订阅金额。Retail 覆盖订单、成品及分销；Production 覆盖采购、材料、物料清单及外协；组合版连接两者。报价取决于模块、地点、集成、品牌规模及实施范围。不能套用通用 POS 模型推测按 MBO 收费，官网明确区分其处理方式。

sections.title_en: Scope training and permissions around real roles
sections.title_zh: 围绕实际角色确定培训与权限
sections.en: Implementation describes workflow understanding, account setup, approval, live training, recorded videos and user practice. Support is stated as 10–6 Monday–Saturday IST. Fashion teams should test showroom access versus production and owner dashboards, including inventory reconciliation. RFID equipment, interface languages, accounting integrations and the advertised AI plugin were not exercised.
sections.zh: 实施流程包括理解业务、账户设置、流程确认、现场培训、录播及练习。支持时间注明印度时间周一至周六 10–6。时尚团队应检查展厅、生产和老板面板各自访问范围及库存核对。RFID 设备、界面语言、会计集成和宣传的 AI 插件未实际测试。

research_gaps.en: Subscription cadence, module limits, RFID costs, exact integration scope and alteration/return behavior remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 订阅周期、模块限制、RFID 费用、具体集成范围及修改退货行为尚未核实。

research_gaps.en: No hands-on account, contract signing, integration, recovery or performance test was conducted; procurement terms and interface languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际登录账户、签署合同、运行集成、测试恢复或性能；采购条款和界面语言仍未核实。
